title: Trees to Sea Scenic Byway
direction: Follows the mapped byway from Cape Meares to Banks.

moments.title: Oceanside
moments.text: From this beach two young men photographed Three Arch Rocks, half a mile offshore, and the hunters at work on them, until Theodore Roosevelt made the rocks a refuge in 1907.

moments.title: Cape Meares
moments.text: At the end of the road a short hike from the parking lot finds the Octopus Tree, a many-trunked Sitka spruce, near the lighthouse whose lens once flashed red and white by turns.
